title: Blank Smithing Template
description: Adds a new "Blank Smithing Template" that can be found in structures, allowing duplication of smithing templates without diamonds, encouraging exploration over repetitive mining for a better gameplay experience.
body:
Adds a new "**Blank Smithing Template**" that can be found in structures, allowing duplication of smithing templates without diamonds, encouraging exploration over repetitive mining for a better gameplay experience.

----------

This mod is a learning project created as part of my journey into Minecraft modding. It serves as a practice ground for developing more complex and ambitious mods planned for the future.

As such, active development will conclude once the mod reaches a stable and feature-complete state (typically marked by version `1.0.0`'s release). Updates for newer versions of Minecraft may also be delayed or limited.

Thank you for your interest and support!
